# NEW 2026-11-21 v10.5 Worker 4: Act III Atlantic Hegemony & Act IV Nostos / Imperium Bicephalum (oe_elr_, Slot 74). Generated by gen_elysia_return.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 1. Declare the Nostos Expedition (opens Act IV & oe_sit_elysian_nostos)
oe_elr_dec_declare_nostos = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	only_once = yes
	only_once_scope = country
	potential = {
		is_ai = no
		oe_elr_is_elysia_host = yes
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_elr_nostos_declared }
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_elr_new_world_era_declared }
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_elr_grand_ending_achieved }
		NOT = { owns = location:constantinople }
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_elr_human_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_elr_nostos_thresholds_tt
			oe_elr_nostos_thresholds_met = yes
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = exterior }
	illustration_scope = {
		event_illustration_estate_effect = {
			foreground = estate_type:crown_estate
			background = estate_type:nobles_estate
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_elr_dec_declare_nostos.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_elr_dec_declare_nostos_tt
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_elr_ev13_fired } }
				set_variable = oe_elr_ev13_fired
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_elr.13
			}
			else = {
				oe_elr_begin_nostos = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# 2. Abandon Old World Obsession (peaceful closure: Independent Eternal Era of Nova Elysia)
oe_elr_dec_abandon_old_world = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	only_once = yes
	only_once_scope = country
	potential = {
		is_ai = no
		oe_elr_is_elysia_host = yes
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_elr_new_world_era_declared }
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_elr_grand_ending_achieved }
		NOT = { owns = location:constantinople }
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_elr_human_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_elr_abandon_ready_tt
			OR = {
				has_variable = oe_elr_ev12_fired
				has_global_variable = oe_elr_nostos_declared
				current_year >= 1550
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = {
		event_illustration_estate_effect = {
			foreground = estate_type:burghers_estate
			background = estate_type:crown_estate
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_elr_dec_abandon_old_world.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_elr_dec_abandon_old_world_tt
			oe_elr_proclaim_new_world_era = yes
		}
	}
}
